yad_align.description: Alignment of labels in form dialogs: left, center, right.

yad_always_print_result.description: Print result for any return code.

yad_buttons.description: List of buttons to display. Each item is an object with 'label' (string) and 'code' (number or string). Empty list hides buttons if --no-buttons is not set, but typically buttons are explicit. If empty, default OK/Cancel may be used depending on version, but explicit is safer. Note: yad uses --no-buttons to hide if none provided, but default behavior often includes OK/Cancel if not specified. We generate explicit buttons here.

yad_center.description: Center the dialog window on the screen.

yad_checklist.description: Enable checklist mode for list dialog (checkboxes in first column).

yad_close_on_unfocus.description: Close dialog when focus is lost.

yad_columns.description: Number of columns in a form dialog.

yad_completion.description: Use completion instead of combo-box in entry dialog.

yad_date_format.description: Date format string for calendar output (strftime).

yad_dialog_height.description: Height of the dialog window in pixels.

yad_dialog_text.description: The main instructional or informational text shown in the dialog body.

yad_dialog_title.description: The title text displayed in the window header bar.

yad_dialog_width.description: Width of the dialog window in pixels.

yad_directory_mode.description: Activate directory-only selection in file dialog.

yad_entry_label.description: Label text for the text entry field.

yad_entry_text.description: Initial text value for the entry field.

yad_fields.description: List of form fields. Each item is an object with 'label' (string) and 'type' (string, e.g., 'H', 'RO', 'NUM', 'CHK', 'CB', 'FL', 'DIR'). See man page for types.

yad_file_separator.description: Separator for multiple filenames in file dialog output.

yad_icon_theme.description: Specific GTK icon theme to use.

yad_image.description: Image file or icon name to display in the dialog.

yad_initial_percentage.description: Initial percentage value for progress dialog.

yad_item_separator.description: Separator character for items in combo-box fields.

yad_list_cols.description: List of list dialog columns. Each item is an object with 'header' (string) and 'type' (string, e.g., TEXT, NUM, CHK, RD, BAR, IMG). See man page for types.

yad_listen_notifications.description: Listen for stdin commands to update notification state.

yad_multiple_files.description: Allow multiple file selection in file dialog.

yad_multiple_selection.description: Allow multiple row selection in list dialog.

yad_no_escape.description: Disable Escape key to close dialog.

yad_notification_command.description: Command to run when notification icon is clicked.

yad_notification_menu.description: Context menu string for notification icon (name!action!icon|...).

yad_numeric.description: Use spin button for numeric input in entry dialog.

yad_radiolist.description: Enable radio list mode for list dialog (radio buttons in first column).

yad_response.description: Default exit code to use instead of 0.

yad_rtl.description: Display progress bar from right to left.

yad_save_mode.description: Activate save mode (overwrites confirmation) in file dialog.

yad_separator.description: Separator character for form output data.

yad_show_weeks.description: Show week numbers in calendar dialog.

yad_skip_taskbar.description: Do not show window in taskbar.

yad_sticky.description: Make window visible on all desktops.

yad_text_align.description: Text justification: left, right, center, fill.

yad_timeout.description: Dialog timeout in seconds. 0 disables timeout.

yad_timeout_indicator.description: Position of the timeout indicator: top, bottom, left, right.

yad_window_icon.description: GTK icon name or file path for the window icon.
